TextureBank.counterB.name: clearedCd13c
TextureBank.counterB.comment: only cleared (tex_initBy, tex_clearSetCounters with loadCount); never read

TextureBank.counterC.name: clearedCd140
TextureBank.counterC.comment: only cleared (tex_initBy, tex_clearSetCounters with loadCount); never read

Stage.lightMatrix.name: faintActorMatrix
Stage.lightMatrix.comment: an identity (stage_build): the extra matrix actor_drawIntoView gives ObjectList_queue for an actor whose tint alpha is 0x10 or less (a cloaked actor of a hacking level not below the viewer's, or the start of a spawn fade-in); a mesh with any extra matrix is drawn by the view volume's transparent path (draw_transparent), not draw_opaque

Stage.lastPickup.comment: the map item (Stage.items index) taken last of the big pickups: an extended armour / shield or a 30-s power-up (item_pickup); the next game packet sends it (net_sendGamePacket, then -1) so the other machines mark it taken; -1 none (map load)

Stage.thrustShapes.comment: the thrust effects' shapes Effect\PlasmaThrust-n, IonThrust-n, GravityThrust-n (eight frames each), loaded by effect_initShapes; never read (the thrust puffs, particle kinds 5 .. 7, are drawn as smoke quads)

TunnelRing.moveSteps.comment: menuTunnel_advance: the distance moved so far in this ring's move (+= g_tunnelStep, the frame time x 30 truncated), in or out; at the ring's length (1100; 950 entering the menus; 2200 leaving for a match, g_leavingForMatch) the move ends and it restarts at 0

Scene.respawnTime.comment: seconds the local player (with a team) has been without an active actor (dead or not yet spawned), counted up by frameTime while no chat line is typed and the round is not over or being left; at 10 it respawns (spawnPending) and this is 0 again

Scene.partsCheckTime.comment: seconds to the next check of the local player's parts (actor_checkDataLoss; a failure is dataLossCode 0): counted down by frameTime in a network game (sessionMode 1) and set back to 20 after a check; the check runs only while the local player's actor is alive (state 1), so it goes below 0 while it is dead or watching

Scene.statsTaken.comment: 1: the local player's starting grade (level: grade, levelShown) and score (levelPoints: score, scoreCounted) given to its actor (match_frame, once a match); 0 at scene_startSession

Scene.packetsSent.comment: packets sent this frame (send_packet: every net_send* packet); match_frame adds it to windowSent and clears it

Scene.typeTablePerRow.comment: per type table (headTypes .. boosterTypes, actorItems), how many leading dwords of each record the network data check samples: a check word w picks record (w / n) % count, dword w % n (net_sendGamePacket: sample; net_processGamePacket: table_ok); 6 3 6 7 10 0x18 (Console_ctor)
